text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — Reserved GPU pool `dedicated-eu-west-1` at 100% utilization. Queue length +1200 over last 3m. Autoscaler attempted scale but failed with rate-limit / max_instances_reached. Severity: P1. Paging oncall.

sara (oncall): I'm on it. pinging infra + runtime. @raj @emily can you take?

raj (infra): looking. seeing repeated 429s from autoscaler API: "rate limit exceeded" and a `MaxInstancesReached` on pool controller. Dumping recent controller logs:
```
2026-03-15T02:04:12Z pool-controller[dedicated-eu-west-1] scale_attempt id=xyz status=failed reason=MaxInstancesReached current=128 max=128
2026-03-15T02:04:13Z autoscaler API error 429 "quota exceeded"
```

emily (runtime): confirmed queue spike seems driven by several heavy embedding jobs from a reserved tenant. Metrics: token-throughput increased x4. KV cache misses high. Could be noisy neighbor. Attaching short histogram: queue wait 200ms -> 3s.

taylor (sre): @ops-bot run preemptive-evict --pool dedicated-eu-west-1 --policy noisy-neighbor --limit 10

ops-bot: Started eviction job evict-20260315-01. Targeting low-priority sessions and non-reserved burst tenants. Logs: `evicted 6 sessions, freed 8 GPUs`.

leo (devex): Heads-up — reserve quotas for enterprise customers are supposed to be protected; make sure we're not evicting reserved-tenant sessions. Use `rb list-reservations --pool dedicated-eu-west-1 --format json` before eviction.

raj (infra): good catch. ops-bot report shows two large sessions belonged to `acmehealth-prod` which is a reserved enterprise tenant. We need to avoid impacting them. Rolling back eviction on those sessions.

ops-bot: Rolled back evictions for reservation id `resv-acme-01`. Current freed GPUs: 4.

jen (cs): I'm joining the bridge with AcmeHealth. Notifying them now: "We're aware of increased latency/503s for some inference calls, investigating. Will update in 10m." @support-bot open-ticket acmehealth-INC348123

support-bot: Ticket INC-348123 created and linked to thread. Contact: eng-bridge scheduled.

sara (oncall): We need a live mitigation path: options — (A) manual scale-up of dedicated pool (requires capacity and infra approval), (B) force-quota override for autoscaler, (C) spot downsample heavy jobs. Which is fastest?

raj (infra): Manual scale-up is fastest if we have free capacity in the region. Checking infra pool capacity: `region-capacity eu-west-1 free=6 gpus` — not enough to cover 8 needed. We can reassign from lower-priority reserved pools after approval.

emily (runtime): Patch idea — autoscaler is hitting request rate limit due to rapid concurrent scale attempts. We can apply debounce on controller to serialize scale ops as short term rollback. Pushing hotfix: `pool-controller: debounce_scale 6s` and skip duplicate requests.

taylor (sre): I can apply the debounce patch to the controller pod. Will do a quick canary on controller-1 then roll.

taylor (sre): Applying canary now. kubectl snippet:
```
kubectl -n controlplane set env deploy/pool-controller CANARY_DEBOUNCE=6
kubectl -n controlplane rollout restart deploy/pool-controller-canary-1
```

taylor (sre): Canary up. Observing logs, scale attempts now serialized. Autoscaler 429s reduced.

raj (infra): After canary, autoscaler accepted scale to +4 but now blocked by per-tenant instance cap: `reservation-policy acmehealth-prod max_increase=0` — they are pinned. So even scaling more GPUs doesn't allocate to acme's sessions; those sessions are consuming more than their reservation.

emily (runtime): That means noisy neighbor inside reservation. We should throttle per-session token rate and apply fairness limiter. Rolling limiter for reservation sessions now:

taylor (sre): Command:
```
rb apply-rate-limit --reservation resv-acme-01 --rate 500 tokens/s --burst 200
```

ops-bot: Rate limit applied to resv-acme-01. Observed immediate drop in avg token-per-session from 1200/s -> 420/s.

sara (oncall): Good. That should relieve the queue. CS update to customer?

jen (cs): Sent: "We've applied temporary rate limits to stabilize the cluster; this may affect latency for high-throughput calls. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with postmortem."

support-bot: Customer acknowledged, asked for ETA. Reply: ETA 30-45m for stabilization.

leo (devex): Noting we also saw many KV cache misses for a particular model binary (v4-int8). Suggest warming or rolling model variant to v4-int8-quant2 which has better small-batch performance.

emily (runtime): Rolling fallback model for non-reserved burst tenants. Command:
```
rb set-model-variant --pool dedicated-eu-west-1 --model gptx-v4 --variant v4-int8-quant2 --filter 'tenant!=reserved'
```

ops-bot: Model variant rollout started. Expected to reduce per-token CPU by ~15% for burst traffic.

taylor (sre): Monitoring queue length... it's decreasing from +1200 -> +260 over 12m. Token latency improving. Still seeing sporadic 503s for ACME calls but throughput is stable.

raj (infra): For long-term: need to relax reservation hard cap or implement intra-reservation fairness so a single reservation can't monopolize its reservation. Filing infra task: INFRA-348999.

sara (oncall): TL;DR: immediate actions taken: applied controller debounce hotfix, applied targeted rate-limits to noisy reservation resv-acme-01, rolled model variant for non-reserved tenants, evicted non-reserved low-priority sessions. Customer notified and ticket opened. Current status: partial mitigation, no full resolution yet. Continue monitoring.

jen (cs): Customer wants postmortem + assurance they won't be evicted. We'll coordinate with product/legal for compensation if SLA breached.

sara (oncall): Assigning follow-ups: @raj INFRA-348999, @emily RUNTIME-349000 patch to enforce per-reservation fairness, @leo DEVEX - doc on emergency runbook changes. I'll stay on bridge for 30m.

support-bot: Link created for INFRA-348999: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-348999

ops-bot: Current metrics: pool utilization 92%, queue length 260, avg token latency 420ms. Will post updates every 5m.

sara (oncall): :thumbsup: thanks team. If queue <100 and 503s gone in 20m we'll close the P1 and start postmortem.

last note from taylor (sre): 18:30 UTC — autoscaler debounce rolled to prod. Observability alert thresholds adjusted to avoid cascading scale attempts. Leaving bridge open for customer follow-up.
